metadata.name: Training Range
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: The gunplay test arena: static boards and distance markers at 5 to 200 m, walking and sprinting boards to learn lead, approaching and elevated targets, penetration walls from glass to concrete, dirt, a water tank and bulletproof glass, a recoil wall, destructibles, a medium combat lane with patrolling range troopers, and a close duel room. Every benchmark gun waits at the firing line.
